title: Ultra-freeze Media Preparation
author: David Shis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.z27f8hn
materials: Mix Together the following reagents 3 g Tryptone Soya broth 0.5 g Glucose 2 g Skim milk powder 4 g Glycerol
Solution should be turbid, heterogeneous. Store at RT
Freeze! Store cryovial with ultra-freeze resuspension in -80.

steps.title: Prepare Microbial Cell Material
steps.instruction: Obtain a sufficient amount of stationary phase cell material for resuspension.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate an overnight culture in a media volume that yields a wet cell mass similar to 5mL of Escherichia coli.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells in Ultra-freeze Media
steps.instruction: Resuspend the microbial cells in 1mL of ultra-freeze media, preferably in a labeled cryovial, using one of the following methods based on the source material:

substeps.instruction: If using a lawn of microbes: Scrape the clean plate of solid media containing the microbe monoculture and resuspend the material in 1mL of ultra-freeze media.
If using stationary phase culture: Pellet the cells by spinning down at 5000 rcf for 10 minutes, pipette off the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 1mL of ultra-freeze media.

steps.title: Recover Microbes from Storage
steps.instruction: Recover the microbes from the frozen cryovial for growth.

substeps.instruction: Scrape a small amount of ice from the cryovial.
Inoculate the ice onto solid or liquid media and incubate until growth occurs.
